text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Heh... I did it, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I got results!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Kokura Fish Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Natiiiie! Can you hear us?!

text_block_list.name: People of Kokura
text_block_list.text: You did sooo weeelll!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Heeey! I can hear you! Thank yoooou!

text_block_list.name: People of Kokura
text_block_list.text: Haha, you go, Natureee!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Heh, do you see them? People from the
Kokura
shopping district came to cheer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
We've only talked a little bit, and they
must be
busy too. I can't believe they
showed up.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...When people cheer me on like that, it
makes
me feel like maybe—just
maybe—I'm doing all
right.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I just have to be me and keep moving
forward,
step by step.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even if I don't know if I will ever reach
my goal...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...You know what? I'm going to ask
something a
little embarrassing now.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Can I win against Teio?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Just joking! Forget that I said anyth—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Oh no... Ummm...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yup, I knew you would say that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm a coward for asking you that despite
knowing
your answer, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I need that push to go forward.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Teio... is currently taking on the Classics,
which
means that next, she'll be at...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: The Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So I want to run the Kikuka Sho next
too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: What... do you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho is 3,000 meters, 1,000
meters
longer than the Kokura Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It may be an uphill battle for Nice
Nature. But if
she has made up her mind,
then I'll support her!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You kidding? It's a huge problem. I'm probably not cut out for long-distance races.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But... I just don't feel like giving up.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Let's run the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Siiiigh... That's done. The decision has been made.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
There's no turning back now, Nature.
Head on to
the big race.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But... yeah. It's not a bad thing...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems to have regained a little
confidence,
but she could probably use
a little more of a
boost for the Kikuka
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thinking that, I remember something...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is happy for me, no matter how
I do.
They smile and tell me I did a great
job.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But by myself, I feel so lost. I can't help
but
wonder if I really did my best.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean, with first place, it's easy to tell,
right?
You get a trophy, or in the case of
the Tenno
Sho, a shield-like plaque.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Those trophies are proof you've done
your best,
but you only get that with
first place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maybe there's something I can do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, on the way back from
Kokura...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer, can I have that snack I left
with you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You know, the sweets that the folks in
Kokura
gave me. I thought I'd nibble on
them on the
train.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rustle... Plop...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh, something fell out.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's an... origami... trophy? It looks kinda
floppy.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You did, did you? Huh, I didn't expect
you to
have such a cute hobby.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wait, what?! Me? But why?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: My confidence?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I understand how it can be hard to have

confidence even when you're doing well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that I thought maybe having
something
tangible to show for her
accomplishments might
give her that
extra confidence.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You did this... for me...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You, an adult, were trying to make this
origami
trophy in the hotel room?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm not five, you know.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I realized after I made it that she might
take it as
me treating her like a child, so
I've been hesitant
to give it to her.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Okay, you silly. I'll graciously accept this
award.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
What are you surprised about? You
made this for
me, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So come on, hand it over. Or I'm not
going home.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Think about it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
A floppy origami trophy is perfect for
me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The gold foil reminiscent of thin metallic
plating,
the crumpled edges.... It's all
very... me, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I guess it feels... familiar? What I'm
saying is...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I hope the next one will be a bit
better, though.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
There will be more races, right? I can't
be the only
one working hard!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best, so I expect more origami
trophies.
